sideA.trigger: Draw this card and read the other side during step 2 at the end of your first game in September.
sideA.text:
PAUSE
DRAW THIS CARD AND READ THE OTHER SIDE DURING STEP 2 AT THE END OF YOUR FIRST GAME IN SEPTEMBER.

mechanics.whenRead: PAUSE. Drawn during the September setup Legacy-deck reading, after 09-04, which stops on this card. Read side B during step 2 at the end of the first September game, then continue the Legacy deck.
rules: Open door 33 immediately when this side is read.
mechanics.notes: The instruction is singular: "Open the following door:" 33 is in a white box with red type. What is inside it is not printed on this card.
